title: Cosmic Observatory Ruins
description: A surreal fantasy landscape featuring floating stone platforms connected by golden chains, a cracked spherical structure with glowing planetary rings at its center, and a stone tower with a large telescope. A purple ornate chair floats nearby while a waterfall cascades from the tower into a lush green cliffside below, all set against a starry cosmic vortex and pastel sky.
